description.en: Leo dreams of visiting Italy one day — the old buildings, gondolas, gelato, and of course, authentic pizza and pasta. He's even saving up for it. But ask him about France and it's a very different story…
description.ru: Лео мечтает побывать в Италии — старинные здания, гондолы, джелато и, конечно, настоящая пицца и паста. Он даже откладывает на это деньги. Но спроси его о Франции — и реакция будет совсем другой…

en: Present Simple for opinions & wants (he wants, he loves)
Present Continuous for future plan (he is saving money)
Object relative clause (a country that Leo wants to visit)
Contrast (but — he loves Italy vs. he hates France)
ru: Present Simple для мнений и желаний (he wants, he loves)
Present Continuous для будущего плана (he is saving money)
Объектное относительное придаточное (a country that Leo wants to visit)
Противопоставление (but — he loves Italy vs. he hates France)

Present Continuous for current action (he is watching Breaking Bad)
Possessive structures (his sister gifted him, his favorite team)
Reason clause with 'because' (he says it helps him because…)

Present Continuous для текущего действия (he is watching Breaking Bad)
Притяжательные конструкции (his sister gifted him, his favorite team)
Придаточное причины с 'because' (he says it helps him because…)

tip.en: Listen for the two main hobbies mentioned and all the specific details Leo shares about each one.

en: Past Simple for completed events (they met, they talked, they said goodbye)
Past Simple reported speech (Leo told Sam about…, Sam said it was…)
Future 'going to' (he is going to go to England)
'Will' for emotional prediction (Leo will miss his friend)
ru: Past Simple для завершённых событий (they met, they talked, they said goodbye)
Косвенная речь — Past Simple (Leo told Sam about…, Sam said it was…)
Будущее 'going to' (he is going to go to England)
'Will' для эмоционального предсказания (Leo will miss his friend)

tip.en: Pay attention to what Sam is doing now and where he is going — and listen carefully to the very last line of the story.
tip.ru: Обрати внимание на то, чем сейчас занимается Сэм и куда он отправляется — и внимательно слушай самую последнюю фразу истории.

Пассивный оттенок в Past Simple (it was all alone, it was very thin)
Временные выражения (the next day, a few days later)
Present Simple для нового состояния/результата (now Leo wants to have his own cat)

tip.ru: Следи за всеми шагами, которые Лео предпринимает для помощи котёнку — и подумай, как эта история связана с тем, что мы знаем о его характере.

stories.description: Mirra Andreeva wins the French Open — then the friends argue about the prize money.

description.en: Mirra Andreeva wins the French Open — then the friends argue about the prize money.
description.ru: Мирра Андреева выигрывает Ролан Гаррос — а друзья спорят о призовых.

bio.en: The youngest Russian champion at Roland Garros since Maria Sharapova.
bio.ru: Самая молодая российская чемпионка Ролан Гаррос со времён Марии Шараповой.

bio.en: One of them doesn't follow tennis at all. Together they guess the prize money and argue whether it's fair.
bio.ru: Один из них совсем не следит за теннисом. Вместе они угадывают размер призовых и спорят, справедливо ли это.

description.en: A news report: Mirra Andreeva wins the French Open and becomes the youngest Russian champion since Maria Sharapova. Facts, dates and numbers — the kind of listening where one missed word changes the answer.
description.ru: Новостной репортаж: Мирра Андреева выигрывает Открытый чемпионат Франции и становится самой юной российской чемпионкой со времён Марии Шараповой. Факты, даты и цифры — то самое аудирование, где одно пропущенное слово меняет ответ.

en: Past Simple for reporting events (she won, she defeated, she became)
Superlatives (the youngest, the first)
Numbers, dates and ages spoken aloud
Present Perfect for records that still stand (only three have won)
ru: Past Simple в новостях о событиях (she won, she defeated, she became)
Превосходная степень (the youngest, the first)
Числа, даты и возраст на слух
Present Perfect для рекордов, которые всё ещё в силе (only three have won)

tip.en: Numbers are where this one is won or lost. Listen for her age and the prize money — both come up again in the discussion.
tip.ru: Здесь всё решают цифры. Слушай её возраст и размер призовых — они ещё всплывут в обсуждении.

description.en: Now the friends react to the same news. One of them does not follow tennis at all, they try to guess the prize money, and the conversation turns to whether it is fair. Natural speech, interruptions and opinions.
description.ru: Теперь друзья реагируют на ту же новость. Один из них совсем не следит за теннисом, они пытаются угадать размер призовых, и разговор сворачивает на то, честно ли это. Живая речь, перебивания и мнения.

en: Asking for and giving opinions (I think, do you really believe)
Guessing and estimating (take a guess, it must be about)
Agreeing and disagreeing (you are kidding, that is insane)
Comparatives for fairness (more than, less than, harder than)
ru: Как спросить и высказать мнение (I think, do you really believe)
Догадки и прикидки (take a guess, it must be about)
Согласие и несогласие (you're kidding, that's insane)
Сравнительная степень в споре о честности (more than, less than, harder than)

tip.en: You already heard the facts in part 1. Here, listen for how people react to them — the useful language is the reaction, not the number.
tip.ru: Факты уже прозвучали в первой части. Здесь слушай, как люди на них реагируют: полезный язык — в реакциях, а не в цифрах.

tip.ru: Это самый эмоционально насыщенный эпизод во всей серии «Сложный». Слушай финальную фразу, которую Дэниел записывает в блокнот — она переосмысливает всё, что он говорил на протяжении всех десяти историй.

quiz.question: What was San Sebastián meant to represent for Daniel and his family?
options: The final client meeting before heading back to London
A shopping day Sandra had planned months in advance
The rest day — the dessert after the vegetables, earned after completing all the work
A city Daniel had always wanted to visit purely for personal reasons

quiz.question: What business crisis interrupted the family's rest day in San Sebastián?
options: A key client cancelled a major contract without any warning
A refrigerated shipment threw a temperature alarm, leaving two hours before the point of no return
One of Daniel's drivers was involved in an accident on a Spanish motorway
The cold-chain facility they had just visited failed its safety inspection

quiz.question: What steps did Daniel take from the café vestibule to resolve the crisis?
options: He rerouted to a closer dock, swapped trailers, approved overtime with hazard pay, and added a video seal check
He delegated everything to his operations manager and rejoined his family immediately
He called the client to request a 24-hour delivery extension and offered a discount
He instructed the driver to reduce speed to protect the temperature-sensitive cargo

quiz.question: What did Daniel do before the client had even noticed the problem?
options: He waited to see if the shipment would recover on its own
He informed his insurance company and started a liability claim
He texted the client, owned the variance, and sent the fix and timestamps as proof
He asked his operations manager to draft a formal written apology

quiz.question: What line did Daniel write while walking the wet promenade that evening?
options: "Balance is the key to a successful business and family life."
"Never mix business travel with family holidays again."
"Boundaries aren't walls; they're promises with timestamps."
"The business must always come first, or neither side survives."
